classes.name: GeomLProp
classes.summary: These global functions compute the degree of continuity of a 3D curve built by concatenation of two other curves (or portions of curves) at their junction point.

staticMethods.name: Continuity
staticMethods.signature: (C1: Geom_Curve, C2: Geom_Curve, u1: number, u2: number, r1: boolean, r2: boolean, tl: number, ta: number): GeomAbs_Shape
staticMethods.comment: Computes the regularity at the junction between C1 and C2. The booleans r1 and r2 are true if the curves must be taken reversed. The point u1 on C1 and the point u2 on C2 must be confused. tl and ta are the linear and angular tolerance used two compare the derivative.

staticMethods.name: Continuity
staticMethods.signature: (C1: Geom_Curve, C2: Geom_Curve, u1: number, u2: number, r1: boolean, r2: boolean): GeomAbs_Shape
staticMethods.comment: The same as preceding but using the standard tolerances from package {@link Precision | `Precision`}.

classes.name: GeomLProp_CurAndInf2d
classes.summary:
An algorithm for computing local properties of a curve. These properties include:
- the maximum and minimum curvatures
- the inflection points. A CurAndInf2d object provides the framework for:
- defining the curve to be analyzed
- implementing the computation algorithms
- consulting the results.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Initializes the framework. Note: The curve on which the local properties are computed is defined using one of the following functions: Perform, PerformCurExt or PerformInf.

instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.comment: For the curve C, Computes both the inflection points and the maximum and minimum curvatures.

instanceMethods.name: PerformCurExt
instanceMethods.comment: For the curve C, Computes the locals extremas of curvature.

instanceMethods.name: PerformInf
instanceMethods.comment:
For the curve C, Computes the inflections. After computation, the following functions can be used:
- IsDone to check if the computation was successful
- NbPoints to obtain the number of computed particular points
- Parameter to obtain the parameter on the curve for each particular point
- Type to check if the point is an inflection point or an extremum of curvature of the curve C. Warning These functions can be used to analyze a series of curves, however it is necessary to clear the table of results between each computation.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: True if the solutions are found.

classes.name: GeomLProp_SLProps
classes.summary: Template class for computing local properties of a 3D surface: point, first and second derivatives, tangent directions, normal, and curvature analysis (max, min, mean, Gaussian).

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: idem as previous constructor but without setting the value of parameters and <V> and the surface. the surface can have an empty constructor.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: idem as previous constructor but without setting the value of parameters and <V>.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (S: Geom_Surface, U: number, V: number, N: number, Resolution: number)
constructors.comment: Initializes the local properties of the surface for the parameter values (, <V>). The current point and the derivatives are computed at the same time, which allows an optimization of the computation time. <N> indicates the maximum number of derivations to be done (0, 1, or 2). For example, to compute only the tangent, N should be equal to 1. <Resolution> is the linear tolerance (it is used to test if a vector is null).

instanceMethods.name: SetSurface
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes the local properties of the surface S for the new surface.

instanceMethods.name: SetParameters
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes the local properties of the surface S for the new parameter values (, <V>).

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the point.

instanceMethods.name: D1U
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the first U derivative. The derivative is computed if it has not been yet.

instanceMethods.name: D1V
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the first V derivative. The derivative is computed if it has not been yet.

instanceMethods.name: D2U
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the second U derivatives The derivative is computed if it has not been yet.

instanceMethods.name: D2V
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the second V derivative. The derivative is computed if it has not been yet.

instanceMethods.name: DUV
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the second UV cross-derivative. The derivative is computed if it has not been yet.

instanceMethods.name: IsTangentUDefined
instanceMethods.comment: returns True if the U tangent is defined. For example, the tangent is not defined if the two first U derivatives are null.

instanceMethods.name: TangentU
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the tangent direction <D> on the iso-V.
@param D Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: IsTangentVDefined
instanceMethods.comment: returns if the V tangent is defined. For example, the tangent is not defined if the two first V derivatives are null.

instanceMethods.name: TangentV
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the tangent direction <D> on the iso-V.
@param D Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: IsNormalDefined
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if the normal is defined.

instanceMethods.name: Normal

instanceMethods.name: IsCurvatureDefined
instanceMethods.comment: returns True if the curvature is defined.

instanceMethods.name: IsUmbilic
instanceMethods.comment: returns True if the point is umbilic (i.e. if the curvature is constant).

instanceMethods.comment: Returns the maximum curvature.
